title: Operator System Card
summary: Drawing from OpenAI’s established safety frameworks, this document highlights our multi-layered approach, including model and product mitigations we’ve implemented to protect against prompt engineering and jailbreaks, protect privacy and security, as well as details our external red teaming efforts, safety evaluations, and ongoing work to further refine these safeguards.
body: Drawing from OpenAI’s established safety frameworks, this document highlights our multi-layered approach, including model and product mitigations we’ve implemented to protect against prompt engineering and jailbreaks, protect privacy and security, as well as details our external red teaming efforts, safety evaluations, and ongoing work to further refine these safeguards.
summaryZh: 操作员系统卡。借鉴 OpenAI 已建立的安全框架，本文档重点介绍了我们的多层方法，包括我们为防止快速工程和越狱、保护隐私和安全而实施的模型和产品缓解措施，并详细介绍了我们的外部红队工作、安全评估以及进一步完善这些保障措施的持续工作。
